messages:
Rebecca (Recruiter): Quick update 1: Candidate Emily accepted the L4 offer yesterday. She just messaged saying she needs to move the start date earlier to 2026-04-15 because her lease overlap is forcing an earlier move. We already approved a $10k sign-on.
Jamal (Hiring Manager): I can onboard earlier, but we need the sign-on to land earlier to cover moving costs. Any blockers if we frontload part of the sign-on? @Linda
Linda (People Ops): Two possible approaches: (A) frontload 50% of the sign-on on the first payroll run (requires comp exception + amendment), or (B) issue a one-time relocation stipend outside the sign-on schedule. Option A is preferred by managers but needs comp/legal/payroll coordination.
Rebecca (Recruiter): Manager picks A. Candidate prefers A as well. She can sign an amendment today if needed.
PeopleOps-Bot: New approval created REQ-2026-0843 "Frontload sign-on for early start". Routing: Comp Committee -> Legal -> Payroll. Standard SLA: 3 business days. Link: https://internal.redwood/req/REQ-2026-0843
Maya (Comp): Please include manager justification (risk of losing candidate) and confirmation that base comp unchanged. I can fast-track if docs are complete.
Sanjay (Legal): No legal barriers but we need an amendment that includes payment schedule and a clawback for <90-day separation. I can draft a template.
Payroll Bot: Payroll note: to put $5,000 on 2026-04-15 run we need PR# and signed amendment by 2026-04-07 12:00 PT. Otherwise next run is 2026-05-01.
Linda (People Ops): I'll ping the comp chair for expedited decision.
Rebecca (Recruiter): Emily confirms she'll sign amendment today. Attaching candidate acknowledgement now.
PeopleOps-Bot: REQ-2026-0843 status: Escalated to Comp Chair (Maya). Decision requested by 2026-04-07 17:00 PT.
Maya (Comp): Approved. Rationale: early start accommodation to prevent candidate attrition; band unaffected. Approved frontload 50% sign-on. Attach manager justification and candidate signature.
Sanjay (Legal): Draft amendment posted: https://internal.redwood/agreements/AMEND-457. Includes 50% frontload and clawback language. Rebecca please get signed.
Payroll Bot: PR#457-FL received. Scheduling $5,000 for 2026-04-15 and remaining $5,000 for 2026-07-01.
Linda (People Ops): All set. Update offer folder and set onboarding start to 2026-04-15. Noting this as an exception on the candidate record.
Rebecca (Recruiter): Amendment signed by Emily (attached). Confirmed start 2026-04-15. Thanks team! :tada:
Jamal (Hiring Manager): Thanks all. Onboarding checklist updated.
PeopleOps-Bot: REQ-2026-0843 closed: Completed.
